changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: John Doe personal subscription on "Acme Operations Dashboard" for CRITICAL and WARNING via IN_APP adapter.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO subscription (user_id, watchlist_id, target_severities, adapter_config_ids, organization_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( 1, (SELECT id FROM watchlist WHERE name = 'Acme Operations Dashboard' AND organization_id = (SELECT id FROM organization WHERE slug = 'acme-corp')), '["CRITICAL", "WARNING"]'::jsonb, (SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM adapter_config WHERE user_id = 1 AND adapter_type = 'IN_APP' AND organization_id IS NULL), NULL, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '10 days', (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '10 days' );

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Suspend Gamma Solutions org to enable blocked subscription UX indicator testing.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE organization SET status = 'SUSPENDED' WHERE slug = 'gamma-solutions';

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Create "Gamma Client Monitoring" watchlist for Gamma Solutions org, including the gamma.client.portal channel.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO watchlist (name, description, user_id, organization_id, configuration, filters, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( 'Gamma Client Monitoring', 'Client portal monitoring watchlist for Gamma Solutions. Used for suspended org subscription UX testing.', 1, (SELECT id FROM organization WHERE slug = 'gamma-solutions'), jsonb_build_object( 'channelIds', (SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM channel WHERE slug = 'gamma.client.portal') ), '{"timeRange": "24h", "onlyCritical": false, "sortBySeverity": true, "groupedView": false}'::jsonb, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days', (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' );

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: John Doe personal subscription on "Gamma Client Monitoring" for CRITICAL and WARNING via IN_APP. Renders as BLOCKED because Gamma Solutions is suspended.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO subscription (user_id, watchlist_id, target_severities, adapter_config_ids, organization_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( 1, (SELECT id FROM watchlist WHERE name = 'Gamma Client Monitoring' AND organization_id = (SELECT id FROM organization WHERE slug = 'gamma-solutions')), '["CRITICAL", "WARNING"]'::jsonb, (SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM adapter_config WHERE user_id = 1 AND adapter_type = 'IN_APP' AND organization_id IS NULL), NULL, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '15 days', (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '15 days' );

changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Mattermost adapter config for Acme Corporation (user 1, org-level) for testing org-scoped notification adapters.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO adapter_config (user_id, organization_id, adapter_type, label, config, enabled, system_managed) VALUES ( 1, (SELECT id FROM organization WHERE slug = 'acme-corp'), 'MATTERMOST', 'Acme Mattermost Alerts', '{"webhookUrl": "https://mattermost.acme.local/hooks/test-webhook-id"}'::jsonb, true, false );
